images.title: Cube on a corner: a regular hexagon
images.purpose: Shows the isometric projection of a glass cube balanced on a corner: a regular hexagon with 6 equal spokes inside.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One large regular hexagon, pointed at top and bottom, in the centre; three short labels to its right.
images.exact_structure: A regular hexagon with vertices at the top, upper right, lower right, bottom, lower left and upper left; its 6 outline sides drawn thick teal #0072B2. A centre dot. From the centre, 3 solid dark spokes to the bottom, upper right and upper left vertices (the edges at the top corner of the cube), and 3 dashed amber #E69F00 spokes to the top, lower right and lower left vertices (the edges at the bottom corner, seen through the glass). All 12 segments are the same length. Labels at the right: '6 outline edges', '6 inside edges', 'all 12 equal'.

images.takeaway: Balanced on a corner, a cube projects to a regular hexagon with all 12 edges the same length.
images.description: Shows the isometric projection of a glass cube balanced on a corner: a regular hexagon with 6 equal spokes inside.
images.context: Concept T13.C1; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Top and bottom corners both project to the centre; 3 + 3 = 6 inside, 12 − 6 = 6 outline.

image_decisions.why: The hexagon is the picture the whole isometric grid is built on; it must be seen.
